fields.description:
## Context / Problem

Pass 3 (`src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/decide.py`: `validity()`, `impact_plan()`, `pass3_decide`, `pass3_over_findings`) is deterministic and every input it needs is in the v2 sidecar (`sidecar.py:702-703` persists per-finding `block_threshold`/`blocking_enabled` losslessly). `docs/calibration/plan_v5_rescore.py` and `docs/experiments/calibrate_plan_review_thresholds.py` prove the replay works but are one-off scripts with hardcoded baselines.

`orchestrator.pass3_over_findings(findings, verifs, *, execution_review=False)` (`orchestrator.py:662-711`) is the REAL LIVE plan-review path: `_threshold_for` special-cases `"prerequisite-consistency" -> (0.60, True)`, else resolves live via `_criteria.threshold_for(criteria, crit_by_id, gate="plan_review")` (`crit_by_id = registry.by_id()`), bumps `block_threshold = max(bt, 0.80)` when `execution_review and blocking_enabled`; it applies `_restrict_on_target_veto_to_grounded` (neutralizes the on-target veto to `"na"` for findings whose criteria don't intersect `registry.CODEBASE_GROUNDED`) before `review_kernel.pass3_over_findings(..., threshold_for=_threshold_for, impact_fn=review_kernel.impact_plan, execution_review=...)`.

**Registry drift is a distinct axis from `impact_model_version`.** Thresholds live in `criteria_routing.json`, governed by `regver` — not `impact_model_version`. A comparison of "live-resolved thresholds" against a "stored decision" will flip verdicts whenever `regver` has moved since the review ran, even when `impact_model_version` is unchanged — that is registry drift, not a candidate/harness bug, so it must not be conflated with candidate-induced flips. Tier-0 therefore computes THREE distinct things per finding, never two:

1. **stored** — the decision persisted in the sidecar.
2. **replayed-stored** — `review_kernel.pass3_decide` fed the finding's PERSISTED `block_threshold`/`blocking_enabled` (no re-resolution) — a pure harness self-check; this MUST always equal `stored` (byte-identical replay of the same numbers), independent of any registry drift.
3. **live-baseline** — `orchestrator.pass3_over_findings` (current production, live-resolved thresholds) — may legitimately differ from `stored` when `regver` drifted; reported as "registry drift", not a flip.

**Candidate** (`--candidate <name>`) is diffed against **live-baseline**, not `stored` — that is the actual comparison Tier-0 exists for. `--candidate <name>` resolves via `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/candidates/__init__.py`'s `CANDIDATES: dict[str, Candidate]` (`Candidate`: `overlay: dict[str, tuple[float, bool]]` per-criterion threshold/posture override, `impact_fn: Callable = review_kernel.impact_plan`). `"current"` is a built-in entry with an empty overlay and default `impact_fn` (identity check: candidate == live-baseline). The candidate's `threshold_for` mirrors `_threshold_for`'s logic (special case, execution_review bump) resolved against the overlay; `_restrict_on_target_veto_to_grounded` applied identically; then `review_kernel.pass3_over_findings(..., threshold_for=<mirrored>, impact_fn=<candidate's>, execution_review=...)`.

`corpus.build_corpus`'s cache rows are summary-only. `findings`/`verification` need the SAME re-read `labels.py` uses: `corpus._enumerate_event_blobs` + `_batch_cat` matched by `review_event_uuid`, then `data["findings"]` (which also carries each finding's persisted `block_threshold`/`blocking_enabled`).

**Plan-v4->v5 baseline.** `docs/calibration/plan_v5_rescore.py:162` `legacy_impact_plan(attrs)`: the shipped `decide.impact_plan` scores pre-v5 ordinal grades (`low|medium|high`) as 0.0, collapsing the baseline — the script pins `legacy_impact_plan` (line 272) as the PRE-v5 baseline, not shipped `impact_plan`. AC2's replay uses `legacy_impact_plan` (imported) as the OLD-side impact function for this one comparison, paired with `classify`/`RULES` for grade->kind mapping; every other Tier-0 comparison uses `review_kernel.impact_plan`.

Ticket-level labels (`labels.py`, closed) need `show_ticket` per ticket — too slow at full-corpus scale. Label-proxy metrics are SEPARATE, OPTIONAL: computed only over a supplied `labels-<hash>.jsonl`, report states coverage fraction.

## Approach

Build `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/tier0.py` (+ `candidates/__init__.py`, `report.py`, `__main__.py`):

- Input: corpus (`corpus.build_corpus`), OPTIONAL `labels_path`, `--candidate <name>` resolved through `candidates.CANDIDATES[name]` (`KeyError` -> clear error listing known names).
- Full-body re-read per row via `_enumerate_event_blobs`/`_batch_cat`; `data["findings"]` + per-index persisted thresholds + `verification` feed Pass-3.
- `__main__.py`: `python -m rebar.llm.evals.plan_replay tier0 --candidate <name> [--labels <path>]`.
- Per finding compute `stored`, `replayed-stored` (persisted thresholds, `pass3_decide` only — assert-equal to `stored` in tests, not reported as a "flip"), `live-baseline` (`orchestrator.pass3_over_findings`), `candidate` (mirrored resolver + candidate overlay/impact_fn).
- Plan-v4->v5 replay (AC2): `classify`/`RULES` grade->kind mapping, compared against `legacy_impact_plan` as the pre-v5 baseline for that comparison only.
- Report (`tier0-<candidate-name>-<date>.md` + JSON): flip matrix segmented as (a) `stored` vs `live-baseline` = registry-drift count, (b) `live-baseline` vs `candidate` = candidate-induced flips (the primary signal), friction rate, per-criterion deltas, priority distribution shift. IF `labels_path` supplied: label-proxy metrics with coverage fraction. ELSE states metrics not computed.
- Post-verdict floors replayed only when inputs present in the sidecar; otherwise reported as not replayed.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/tier0.py` (new)
- `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/candidates/__init__.py` (new)
- `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/report.py` (new)
- `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/__main__.py` (new)
- `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/replay/tier0-*.md` (generated)
- `tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_tier0.py` (new)

## Testing

Unit: `replayed-stored` (persisted thresholds) exactly equals `stored` for every fixture finding (harness self-check, always true regardless of registry state); a fixture with a registry threshold DIFFERENT from its persisted `block_threshold` shows `live-baseline` != `stored` (registry drift) while `replayed-stored` still == `stored`; candidate `"current"` (no overlay) == `live-baseline` for every finding; an overlay lowering one criterion's threshold flips exactly the findings between old/new thresholds in the candidate-vs-live-baseline comparison; `prerequisite-consistency` special case and `execution_review` bump each exercised once; unknown `--candidate` name raises a clear error; v1 sidecar lacking `block_threshold` skipped and counted; pre-v5 graded row classified via the reused mapping and compared against `legacy_impact_plan`; label-proxy metrics omitted without `labels_path`; `__main__.py`'s `tier0` subcommand dispatches correctly.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `python -m rebar.llm.evals.plan_replay tier0 --candidate current` over the real corpus reports zero `replayed-stored` vs `stored` mismatches (the harness self-check) for every finding; checked by the generated report.
- [ ] Replaying the plan-v4->plan-v5 change (via `classify`/`RULES` + `legacy_impact_plan` as the pre-v5 baseline) reproduces its documented direction and approximate magnitude; checked against `docs/calibration/`.
- [ ] The report separately states registry-drift flips (`stored` vs `live-baseline`) and candidate-induced flips (`live-baseline` vs `candidate`), plus friction rate and per-criterion deltas; checked by inspection of one report.
- [ ] IF a labels file is supplied, the report additionally contains label-proxy metrics with coverage fraction, annotated against the noise band; checked by inspection when available.
- [ ] The Pass-3 replay itself (excluding any optional label-proxy step) completes in under 5 minutes on a laptop over the real corpus, with zero LLM calls; checked by timing and no provider credentials.
- [ ] Unit tests pass in `make test`.
